name: Find the Kittens (43)
desc:
🐱 Find the Kittens is a scavenger hunt game where you must find the kittens hidden across multiple islands. While some kittens are easy to find, others require more skill and patience to locate. Can you find them all?

👍 Please consider liking and favoriting the game if you enjoy it.

👥 Join the group: https://www.roblox.com/communities/646725839/Find-the-Kittens

This game is inspired by many other "Find the" games, especially Find the Stickmen by robey100.
